column1: # Every place a connector keeps its own version of something the chassis
# provides. Read by .github/conformance/conformance.py, which FAILS the build on:
#   * a same-name local copy that is NOT listed here  -> new drift
#   * a line here whose local copy no longer exists   -> stale, the register
# It is a ratchet, not an amnesty. Listing a copy does not bless it; it records
# that someone decided, with a reason, and makes the total visible. Deleting a
# line is the definition of done.
# Fields, tab-separated:  kind  connector  type  path  reason
#   kind=copy     a type with the SAME NAME as one the chassis declares.
#                 Detected automatically. These are the enforced rows.
#   kind=renamed  the same job under a different name. NOT detected
#                 automatically — matching it needs semantic comparison, and a
#                 gate that guesses gets switched off. Recorded so the real

Same public API, DIFFERENT behaviour: this one prunes on a UTC basis (utcNow) where the chassis uses local time (DateTime.Now), so adopting it shifts the retention boundary by the UTC offset; and the chassis additionally prunes decision_ledger_*.jsonl / decisions_*.jsonl, which this connector deliberately does not -- that is the tamper-evident compliance record.

Static class (Record / RecordExclusion / RecordQuarantine / RecordRestriction / Read / Enabled) against the chassis's IDisposable instance. Already SHA-256 hash-chained and tamper-evident, so the swap buys robustness only, at the cost of every call site.

Static class exposing Mirror / Write / ServiceLifecycle(message, starting), where the chassis EventLogSink is a LogHandler INSTANCE exposing Lifecycle(message). Opposite shapes; the two-argument ServiceLifecycle is what this connector's ServiceHost hooks call.

Claims work per OBJECT (TryClaimObject / CompleteObject / FailObject / IsClaimExpired) where the chassis claims per CRAWL (TryClaim / CompleteClaim); it also takes an injected ISqlGateway the chassis version has no equivalent for. Different unit of work, not a different style.

Static class with an explicit Initialize / Shutdown lifecycle, where the chassis EventLogSink is a LogHandler instance created via CreateIfConfigured / InstallOnRoot. Opposite shapes.

Deliberately mirrors CPython logging semantics (console at WARNING+ unless --verbose, log file always at all levels) because this connector is a 1:1 port of the Python original. Chassis components reach it through the Chassis.LoggerFactory seam instead.
Exposes EnsureOwnerOnly / HardenExisting where the chassis exposes EnsureHardened -- two operations against one, and the split is what the call sites use.

Exposes OpenHardened / OpenHardenedAsync / ExecuteAsync taking an explicit connection string, where the chassis exposes a ConnectionString property plus OpenConnection. Different connection-hardening contract, and this connector's SqlStateStore is written against it.

column5: Content-gate capability duplicated across connectors (Clarizen's is named ContentGateStage, so the name check cannot even pair them) with no chassis equivalent. NOT a mechanical extraction like ServiceHost: the three are different security CONTRACTS (verdict shape, fail-mode model, category vocabulary), and the category strings are stamped into the Graph-declared ContentGateStatus property, so unifying them changes indexed values -- a schema re-baseline, not a refactor. Blocked on TOGAF G1's outstanding sponsor decision (the malware-scanning integration contract) which determines the seam.
